summary: Target modality strongly changes presentation while the low-frequency silhouette remains stable. Clay plus normal converges on clay; all-depth is the only cell that adds a fur-like organismal surface.

backgroundRelativeMask.method: Largest four-connected RGB-distance component from a per-image border-median background; threshold 20 RGB Euclidean units.
backgroundRelativeMask.claim: Exploratory silhouette diagnostic only; not a predeclared admission metric.
